scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: node scripts/sync-ai-rules.mjs --check && npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && node scripts/test-db.mjs run -- npm run test:integration -w backend
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/test-db.mjs run -- npm run test:integration -w backend
